title: Scrolling on "Other Applications" page is janky while using grid view mode
line: In Kickoff's grid of all applications, the scrollbar handle keeps the same size and moves smoothly while scrolling.
explanation: The grid of all applications is a ListView whose delegates are one GridView per letter, and those sections have very different heights. ListView only creates the delegates near the visible area and estimates the height of the rest from their average, so its content height changed as different sections came into view: the scrollbar handle grew and shrank and the view jumped while dragging it. The change sets the ListView's cacheBuffer to an upper bound of the whole list's height (two cells per app), so all sections are loaded and the content height is exact.

commits.message:
applets/kickoff: keep all sections loaded in the grid of all applications

Sections in the grid of all applications have very different heights,
so the list could only guess its full height and the scrollbar handle
grew and shrank while scrolling. Loading all sections makes it exact.

BUG: 505334

patches.diff:
From 7335999d60eee9f401c44bc714d1967e1b750c9d Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 10:37:16 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/kickoff: keep all sections loaded in the grid of all
 applications

Sections in the grid of all applications have very different heights,
so the list could only guess its full height and the scrollbar handle
grew and shrank while scrolling. Loading all sections makes it exact.

BUG: 505334
---
 applets/kickoff/ListOfGridsView.qml | 3 +++
 1 file changed, 3 insertions(+)

diff --git a/applets/kickoff/ListOfGridsView.qml b/applets/kickoff/ListOfGridsView.qml
index 1f4b442bf4..5fcaa02888 100644
--- a/applets/kickoff/ListOfGridsView.qml
+++ b/applets/kickoff/ListOfGridsView.qml
@@ -18,6 +18,9 @@ KickoffListView {
     highlight: null // highlight off since it otherwise highlights a whole section
     model: gridModel?.sections ?? null // avoid error while page is switched
     section.property: "section"
+    // Sections have very different heights, so ListView only knows its real content height when all of them are
+    // loaded. A section is never taller than two cells per app, so this buffer always covers the whole list.
+    view.cacheBuffer: 2 * (gridModel?.count ?? 0) * KickoffSingleton.gridCellSize
     delegate: ListOfGridsViewDelegate {
         id: delegate
 
--
